name: zzAC2_eyes_costume

tests.name: the wardrobe is open through the founder's own button
the preview window reports where it is
each capture is a different picture

detail.note: if the wardrobe did not restage, before and after are the same file and this job would pass by photographing one moment three times.

tests.name: the face was measurable before and after the costume

detail.note: an unmeasurable reading here VOIDS the comparison rather than passing it: two Nones are equal, and equality is exactly what this job tests.

tests.name: the middle of the visor did not light up after a costume round trip

detail.note: THE BUG THIS JOB EXISTS FOR puts a third eye BETWEEN the two, because ShowCanonBody would un-hide the original combined pane and draw it alongside both replacements. A gap clause cannot catch it, since the outer peaks do not move, and an absolute peak count cannot be trusted: counting bright runs gives 3 for Relay OG and 8 for Arden on captures that plainly show two eyes.

tests.name: the eyes are in the same place after as before
